nodes.label: route.ts
nodes.description: Defines the HTTP endpoint used to check the website's health.

nodes.label: GET()
nodes.description: Returns an OK status response for container health checks.

nodes.label: capability-gallery.tsx
nodes.description: Defines the bilingual facility photo and video gallery.

nodes.label: CapabilityGallery()
nodes.description: Renders facility media with filters, thumbnails, navigation and an enlarged dialog.

nodes.label: layout.tsx
nodes.description: Defines the root page layout and website metadata.

nodes.label: metadata
nodes.description: Configures the page title, description, brand icons and local-review indexing policy.

nodes.label: RootLayout()
nodes.description: Renders the document with its initial language from the language cookie.

nodes.label: page-interactions.tsx
nodes.description: Defines page-level interaction restrictions requested by the site owner.

nodes.label: PageInteractions()
nodes.description: Registers and cleans up context-menu, keyboard-zoom and gesture restrictions.

nodes.label: page.tsx
nodes.description: Defines the server entry point and homepage viewport configuration.

nodes.label: viewport
nodes.description: Requests a device-width viewport with the page scale fixed to one.

nodes.label: Page()
nodes.description: Reads the language and validated contact settings before rendering the storefront.

nodes.label: product-detail.tsx
nodes.description: Defines the product specification and inquiry dialog.

nodes.label: ProductDetail()
nodes.description: Lets customers select product specifications and prepare or stage a quotation inquiry.

nodes.label: quote-form.tsx
nodes.description: Defines the customer inquiry form and its draft data type.

nodes.label: Inquiry
nodes.description: Represents the customer and delivery details collected for an inquiry.

nodes.label: QuoteForm()
nodes.description: Builds a reviewable quote draft with email, WhatsApp and text-download options.

nodes.label: storefront.tsx
nodes.description: Defines the main portfolio, catalog and quotation interface.

nodes.label: Storefront()
nodes.description: Coordinates language selection, product filtering, dialogs and quotation items.

nodes.label: catalog.ts
nodes.description: Provides material data, categories and the shared catalog types.

nodes.label: Lang
nodes.description: Limits content language to Indonesian or English.

nodes.label: Category
nodes.description: Represents a catalog category identifier.

nodes.label: Variant
nodes.description: Describes a selectable product specification.

nodes.label: Product
nodes.description: Describes a catalog material and its images, specifications and variants.

nodes.label: QuoteItem
nodes.description: Represents a selected product variant, quantity, unit and color for a quote.

nodes.label: products
nodes.description: Exposes the prepared catalog records to the website.

nodes.label: categories
nodes.description: Defines the category choices displayed in the catalog.

nodes.label: categoryName()
nodes.description: Returns a category's label in the selected language.

nodes.label: colours.ts
nodes.description: Provides localized color names and material swatches.

nodes.label: colours
nodes.description: Stores the color-label and swatch mapping.

nodes.label: colourLabel()
nodes.description: Returns a color name in Indonesian or English.

nodes.label: colourSwatch()
nodes.description: Resolves a material color to its display swatch.

nodes.label: inquiry.ts
nodes.description: Formats inquiry text and creates external contact links.

nodes.label: itemText()
nodes.description: Formats a selected material's specifications, quantity and unit for an inquiry.

nodes.label: productInquiry()
nodes.description: Creates a product-specific inquiry message from the selected material.

nodes.label: mailLink()
nodes.description: Encodes an email destination, subject and message into a mailto link.

nodes.label: chatLink()
nodes.description: Encodes an inquiry message into a WhatsApp conversation link.

nodes.label: next.config.ts
nodes.description: Defines the website's Next.js build configuration.

nodes.label: config
nodes.description: Configures standalone output and image settings for the Next.js application.

nodes.label: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.description: Configures the Tailwind CSS PostCSS plugin.

nodes.label: inspect-assets.py
nodes.description: Extracts the local workbook and prepares contact sheets for asset inspection.

nodes.label: prepare-catalog.py
nodes.description: Converts the source workbook and images into catalog data and optimized website assets.

nodes.label: save()
nodes.description: Normalizes and resizes an image before saving it as WebP.

nodes.label: Read the supplied workbook and prepare optimized, traceable website assets.
nodes.description: Documents that catalog preparation should preserve traceability to the supplied workbook.

nodes.label: prepare-gallery.py
nodes.description: Prepares optimized facility photographs, videos and gallery metadata.

nodes.label: BOSS BAHAN PVC
nodes.rationale: Bilingual B2B material portfolio; customers prepare inquiries rather than online purchases.
nodes.description: Bilingual B2B material portfolio; customers prepare inquiries rather than online purchases.

nodes.label: Quotation inquiry
nodes.rationale: Product variants, quantities and delivery requirements become a reviewable customer inquiry.
nodes.description: Product variants, quantities and delivery requirements become a reviewable customer inquiry.

nodes.label: Indonesian and English
nodes.rationale: Language state is persisted in the boss-language cookie.
nodes.description: Language state is persisted in the boss-language cookie.

nodes.label: Catalog data: 27 groups, 99 variants
nodes.rationale: Committed material catalog excludes price fields.
nodes.description: Committed material catalog excludes price fields.

nodes.label: Facility gallery: 11 photos, 6 videos
nodes.rationale: Authentic facility documentation with lazy media loading.
nodes.description: Authentic facility documentation with lazy media loading.

nodes.label: Optimized public assets
nodes.rationale: WebP product photography and compressed silent videos ship with the website.
nodes.description: WebP product photography and compressed silent videos ship with the website.

nodes.label: Local source assets and workbook
nodes.rationale: Original photographs and workbook remain local; prepared assets support a fresh clone.
nodes.description: Original photographs and workbook remain local; prepared assets support a fresh clone.

nodes.label: Black-and-gold brand identity
nodes.rationale: All brand names read BOSS BAHAN PVC; the hero seal has BOSS APPROVED above and five gold stars below.
nodes.description: All brand names read BOSS BAHAN PVC; the hero seal has BOSS APPROVED above and five gold stars below.

nodes.label: Illustrative tarpaulin photo
nodes.rationale: AI-generated finished-tarpaulin imagery is labeled illustrative in product details.
nodes.description: AI-generated finished-tarpaulin imagery is labeled illustrative in product details.

nodes.label: Runtime contact configuration
nodes.rationale: The server validates SALES_EMAIL and WHATSAPP_NUMBER from local environment settings.
nodes.description: The server validates SALES_EMAIL and WHATSAPP_NUMBER from local environment settings.

nodes.label: Email draft via mailto
nodes.rationale: The customer reviews and sends the email in their own email application.
nodes.description: The customer reviews and sends the email in their own email application.

nodes.label: WhatsApp draft via wa.me
nodes.rationale: Product details are encoded into a WhatsApp conversation link; the customer sends it.
nodes.description: Product details are encoded into a WhatsApp conversation link; the customer sends it.

nodes.label: Downloadable inquiry summary
nodes.rationale: A local text summary accompanies the reviewable quotation draft.
nodes.description: A local text summary accompanies the reviewable quotation draft.

nodes.label: Responsive header and hero
nodes.rationale: One-line wordmark and announcement ticker; hero seal aligned with the slogan.
nodes.description: One-line wordmark and announcement ticker; hero seal aligned with the slogan.

nodes.label: Page interaction policy
nodes.rationale: Owner-requested page zoom/context menu restrictions preserve normal scrolling and form entry.
nodes.description: Owner-requested page zoom/context menu restrictions preserve normal scrolling and form entry.

nodes.label: Next.js standalone runtime
nodes.rationale: The multi-stage Docker build runs as a non-root user.
nodes.description: The multi-stage Docker build runs as a non-root user.

nodes.label: Docker localhost review
nodes.rationale: Compose binds 127.0.0.1:3036 to container port 3000.
nodes.description: Compose binds 127.0.0.1:3036 to container port 3000.

nodes.label: Graphify project map
nodes.rationale: Development-only graph and Studio stay outside the website runtime.
nodes.description: Development-only graph and Studio stay outside the website runtime.

nodes.label: Compose web service
nodes.rationale: Loopback-only Docker service with configurable contact environment and restart policy.
nodes.description: Loopback-only Docker service with configurable contact environment and restart policy.

nodes.label: Project setup and operating guide
nodes.rationale: Documents Docker review, data provenance and Graphify usage, with inquiries directed to berkahmultiplastik@gmail.com and WhatsApp +62 851-9551-8078.
nodes.description: Documents Docker review, data provenance and Graphify usage, with inquiries directed to berkahmultiplastik@gmail.com and WhatsApp +62 851-9551-8078.
